title: Kitchen connections
description: Sort 16 kitchen words into four groups.

groups.name: Cooking methods
groups.explanation: Ways of cooking food using heat and liquid or fat.

groups.name: Ways of cutting
groups.explanation: Specific techniques for cutting ingredients into particular shapes or sizes.

groups.name: Kitchen tools
groups.explanation: Utensils and equipment used to prepare or serve food.

groups.name: Taste and texture
groups.explanation: Adjectives used to describe how food tastes or feels in the mouth.
